decisions.reason: The burner component serves the core gas radiant heater business and its installed base, so it costs little to keep and remains useful for service and spare parts.
The electric infrared panel line is a flagship with several models and fits the firm's shift toward electrified, lower-carbon heating.
The industrial electric hall heater line sits close to the core hall-heating business and meets ongoing demand for electric alternatives in large spaces.
The hydrogen-capable dark infrared series is a strategic flagship with a documented real-world pilot, and it anchors the firm's hydrogen-ready direction.
